delegate.description: The key that receives the grant.

audience.description: Only on short-lived, unstored capabilities that prove account ownership to a peer or HTTP server; never on stored grants.

path.description: Path the grant is scoped to, recursive by segment (`/team` covers `/team/notes`); empty for the whole space.

role.description: What the delegate may do: `WRITER` publishes under `path`, `AGENT` acts as the issuer (path must be empty).

label.description: Public, immutable note describing the grant, at most 512 bytes.

description: A signed grant from a space owner to another key: a `WRITER` or `AGENT` role, optionally scoped to a path.
